# usage: api.sh GET PATH   |   api.sh POST PATH BODYFILE

M=$1; P=$2; B=$3
if [ "$M" = "POST" ]; then
  wget -q -O - --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
    --post-file="$B" --no-check-certificate "https://10.96.0.1:443$P"
else
  wget -q -O - --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --no-check-certificate \
    "https://10.96.0.1:443$P"
fi
EOF
